prompt.note: "You are a sentiment classifier...Return one digit only: 2/1/0..." -- a short, complete system prompt quoted in full.

claim.location: Sec 3, over the full corpus (Table 1 total=100,502)

notes: gpt-4.1-nano fills a second annotation pass rather than the paper's headline task, but the accuracy-vs-human comparison is a genuine, fully re-executable classification claim: full 3-way prompt, full corpus, printed accuracy and kappa.
